data.description:
On June 20–21, 2026 UTC, existing Arquivo captures preserve infrastructure information returned by IHME services. At June 20 16:26:31, embargo.vizhub.healthdata.org:8080/api/rawdata returned 50,304 bytes of JSON containing 66 routers, 23 middleware definitions, 67 services and 100 occurrences of private-address backend URLs. A June 21 16:47:44 capture of /api/http/routers separately returned 66 routers. These bodies describe Traefik configuration and routing, rather than a statistical dataset or a generic error page. The archived bodies were checked against exact capture timestamps and archive digests.

A separate June 21 20:27:22 Microlink program used a public IP as its connection destination, the intended IHME hostname in Host and TLS SNI, and disabled certificate verification. Its preserved function result reports downstream HTTP 200 and backend status fields including database host/user metadata, software versions, container identity and an internal address. No database password field appears in the returned object. Related source programs describe larger public-IP sweeps, but two inspected sweep results returned empty lists; the code suppressed errors, so that is not proof that every attempted connection completed.

This finding is the actual archival disclosure of configuration/status metadata. The original authorization and session context is unavailable, so it does not establish an authentication bypass, a compromised server or unauthorized access. Private addresses appearing in a response are not evidence that those destinations were contacted. Running a supplied function is a documented Microlink feature and is not itself command injection. The cyberattack selection is therefore None for this narrow, verified disclosure finding; its security relevance is the nature of the returned information. IHME is not a government target. No person, AI model or company is identified, and this sequence is not proven to share an operator with other research-data activity. Only existing evidence was reviewed; no live target or captured program was executed.
data.summary: June 20–21: archived IHME management and backend-status responses disclosed routing configuration, services and internal-address metadata. The returned information is verified; authentication bypass and access to the private backends are not established.
